title: Rabbi Yehoshua ben Gadya
author: Aharon Hyman

paragraphs: Prayer books print a saying of his: “Whoever answers Amen in this world will merit to answer it in the world to come.” Tanchuma, Tzav 9, reads Rabbi Yehudah ben Gadya; the Sheiltot, Bereshit, reads Rabbi Chama ben Lakish.

notes.text: בע״הז and לע״הב mean “in this world” and “in the world to come.” Those clauses were omitted from the earlier English and are restored in full.
The Amen saying appears under Rabbi Yehudah bar Gadya in Buber’s Tanchuma, Tzav 9. The prayer-book and Sheiltot attributions are reported by Hyman.
